title: Personal Checking: ATM, debit card and Zelle limits by tier
content:
## Scope

This limits sheet shows how much a Personal Checking owner can take out of the account through ATMs, debit card purchases and Zelle payments, per tier.

## Limits by tier

| Tier | ATM cash withdrawn per calendar day (USD) | Debit card purchase value authorized per calendar day (USD) | Zelle payments sent per calendar day (USD) | Zelle payments sent in any rolling 30 calendar days (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 500.00 | 2500.00 | 500.00 | 2000.00 |
| Student Checking | 400.00 | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 2000.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 800.00 | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 10000.00 |
| Interest Checking | 1000.00 | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 10000.00 |
| Premier Checking | 1500.00 | 7500.00 | 5000.00 | 20000.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 2500.00 | 15000.00 | 10000.00 | 40000.00 |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Are the ATM and debit card figures separate limits?**
A: Yes. ATM cash and debit card purchases each have their own per-day figure in the table.

**Q: Which tier has the lowest ATM figure?**
A: Student Checking, at 400.00 USD per calendar day; Access Checking is 500.00 USD.

**Hypothetical case**: a Premier Checking owner has sent 18000.00 USD by Zelle in the rolling 30 calendar days and wants to send 3000.00 USD today. The daily figure of 5000.00 USD would allow it, but 18000.00 and 3000.00 together make 21000.00 USD, which is above the 30-day figure of 20000.00 USD.
